_readme: Reversals this tree declares, for scripts/ci/check-silent-revert.py (ADR-1284).
A reversal is only silent when nothing in the repository says it was meant.
An entry is not a path exclusion: the gate matches a finding against it only
when the detector, the exact path, the commit being undone and every single
evidence line all agree, so the entry covers one migration and stays silent
about anything else that later touches the same file.
Fields: adr (the decision that supersedes the reverted work), kind (which
detector), undoes (full target sha, mandatory for reverse-hunk), paths
(exact repository paths), evidence (a regex every matched line must satisfy),
reason (what a reviewer needs in order to agree).
A one-off revert with no ADR behind it is declared in the PR instead:

reversals.reason: c2a3c7e0f (#1067) rewrote every dataset path from `.corpus/` to the retired numbered workspace directory. ADR-1277 (Accepted, 2026-09-20) names that rename `the incorrect first migration attempt` and splits local data into `.workingdir/` for machine-local state and `.corpus/` for datasets; scripts/ci/check-local-data-contract.sh is the required gate that keeps the retired root out. Restoring `.corpus/` in these files is that decision landing, not work being lost. The evidence regex is written `\.workingdir\d?` rather than naming the retired root, because scripts/ci/check-local-data-contract.sh forbids an active file from spelling it; it still holds the entry to the path text: across all sixteen files every line this finding rests on carries the retired root or `.corpus/`, and nothing else of c2a3c7e0f is touched.

The `buf_dev` tier is ADR-0759, landed by 31a51afb2 (#101) and silently reverted by 92ea978a4 (#102) — the pair ADR-1284 was written from. Master still carries the reverted state, so restoring it is text master once held and lost coming back, which is what `resurrected` is for. docs/state.md records it as T-HIP-ADM-BUFFER-BY-POINTER-REVERTED-2026-09-21 and docs/rebase-notes.md tells the next rebase how to resolve it. The branch's own 6811ef63d writes these lines; the finding survives only because the later unwind-helper reconciliation re-indents a second copy of each, so the merge holds one more occurrence than any single commit added.
